title: event.faqs
description: A list of at most 30 frequently asked questions about the event. Each item contains a `question` and an `answer` in at least one of the languages `nl`, `fr`, `de` or `en`. When the event has no FAQs, `faqs` is omitted from the event GET response. When `faqs` is left out of a full `PUT /events/{eventId}` body, the existing FAQs are removed.
